PROGRAM gate
VAR
    State : INT;
    MotorOpen : BOOL;
    MotorClose : BOOL;
END_VAR

State := CASE
    WHEN NOT MotorOpen AND NOT MotorClose THEN
        IF OpenCmd AND NOT OpenLimit AND NOT Obstruction THEN
            1
        ELSIF CloseCmd AND NOT CloseLimit AND NOT Obstruction THEN
            2
        ELSE
            0
        END_IF
    WHEN State = 1 THEN
        IF OpenLimit OR Obstruction THEN
            0
        ELSE
            1
        END_IF
    WHEN State = 2 THEN
        IF CloseLimit OR Obstruction THEN
            0
        ELSE
            2
        END_IF
    ELSE
        0
    END_CASE;

MotorOpen := (State = 1) AND NOT Obstruction;
MotorClose := (State = 2) AND NOT Obstruction;
END_PROGRAM
